meals.note: Diego supports Nuzzuo, Lilian and Theodora: start the pairs that keep growing in Part III.

missables.text: Fight Dietrich's Paralogue on 10/16 or 10/17, Orchel's from 10/18, Cai's battle on 10/22
missables.lose: each Paralogue's 20,000G, 150 Renown and item; Orchel's also gates Diego
detail: Ignore the listed end dates (Dietrich's 11/1, Orchel's 10/27): the chapter ends 10/24.
Quests dated after 10/24 end with Part I on 10/24 too.

missables.text: Recruit Diego, and Benditz if he's still waiting, by 10/24: Part II has no recruiting
missables.lose: both recruits for the rest of the route
detail: Benditz short of Renown 8 in Ch 11? Recruit him on 10/16 (his row is in Ch 10).

missables.text: Hold every cursed item when Part I ends (storage counts): Ursa's Claw and 9 chest items
missables.lose: those items in Part III: the Drifting Reliquary re-sells only what you held
missables.recover: None: Part I chests don't refill
detail: Turmoil Mask, Poisonbone Chain, Veroquine, Azaga's Bow, Muen, Gundogya, Velheit, Anguishing Shield, Onoa.
Part III users own them: Theodora (Muen), Orchel, Eshmel and Anatolia (their build pages).

note.text: Priorities 1 to 8 still waiting: take the Advanced exam now if Lv 35 and the ranks are in
detail: Sirocco, Loretta (Shido) and Ultand (Guardian) only at Lv 35 with the ranks; else Part II Ch 1.
Giant's-Print Fort (Spare Turns) has an Advanced License in a chest.

override.text: Short of Lv 35? Stay Shaman for the finale; Ovate once he hits Lv 35 in Part II

assign.why: Orchel's Regret reward, if a repeat barter didn't give her one
Stolen Star Observations reward: White toward A

note.text: Blacksmith +2 week (Renown 10): every Ch 12 row in the Ledger's refine plan, before the finale
detail: Rare ore: Mahadu's Spear, Longbow, Levin Sword and Hammer to +2.
Da Mina (ores ?): every +1 to +2; buy Ninae's and Ultand's Spears, refine Noctula's Gauntlets and Diego's Sword.
Smithing Stone: Simon's Iron Sword, Nydine's Iron Spear. Part II carries only what units hold.

recruits.action: Recruit him right after Orchel's Paralogue: storage until Part III
detail: No Part I or II build: he waits for Part III.

callout.text: He also needs Renown 8. Still short on 10/16?
bullets: Hand in every open Send Supplies quest and run Dietrich's Paralogue before Orchel's.
Not there by 10/24: he can't join this route's army.

paralogue.note: Do it first, on 10/16 or 10/17: put one or two archers east for the Pegasus Knights
detail: A 10-turn defense. Lilian's Da Mina Bow (Effective+ vs fliers) covers the east.

paralogue.note: Split into two teams to hit both switches on the same turn; Pegasus come from the east
The battle is on 10/22: rush Centurio

explore.text: Before 10/24: unassign battalions from anyone you skip in Part III
detail: An assigned squad stays on that unit's Clear Data; else buy it back at the Drifting Reliquary.
Sirocco takes [[battalion:Shadow Mages]] at Authority B.
Part II use is undocumented ?; Part III keeps them in storage (medium confidence).
Run it with your support pairs.
Onoa is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Part III: Eshmel's spear (his build page).

explore.text: Spend any Turns still left on Inn Auto-Activities

tips.text: One spiral route climbs to the boss: dismount cavalry before the stairs, they move farther on foot
Anatolia and Sha Lan arrive mid-battle if you loaned the ship in Ch 10
Pack Theodora's [[item:Dew of Protection]] for the Dyan turn
detail: The Dew takes the Short Spear's slot for that turn, then put the Short Spear back.

callout.text: Two reinforcement waves hit from behind on the first stair climb; many are fliers
bullets: Swap Lilian in for Bonaventure: her bows and Sirocco's magic face the rear.
Alexandra and Lysander stay out of their range.
